recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy music compilation cover featuring a dark magenta and black color scheme, characterized by a central row of overlapping circular portrait frames and a grid-like 'disco ball' light effect in the background. The layout is strictly horizontal, with large display typography at the top and a tracklist section at the bottom composed of rounded horizontal bars.
coreVisualRelationships: Overlapping circular frames containing artist portraits as the central focal point
Large, bold display title anchored to the top margin
Horizontal pill-shaped containers for track information at the base
A glowing magenta halftone/dot pattern providing texture to the dark background
coreInvariants: Circular masking for all primary imagery
White or light pink sans-serif typography for legibility against dark tones
Glossy, beveled edges on UI-like elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four circular portrait windows occupy the center third of the vertical space, spanning the full width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large display title at the top acts as the primary anchor, balanced by the heavy tracklist block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Title -> Artist Portraits -> Tracklist -> Year/Volume marker at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the design is densely packed with information and decorative light effects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Magenta/Hot Pink for highlights and UI elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for the primary background and depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for high-contrast text and glowing light effects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pinks with high value contrast between white text and black backgrounds.

letterConstructionRules: Extra bold weights for display titles
Rounded terminals to match the circular framing motifs
Tight letter spacing (tracking) for a compact, energetic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title text features a vertical stripe or inline effect to suggest motion or light
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, stylized display face paired with a clean, functional sans-serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and presence for the main title.
Clean legibility for the tracklist and secondary info.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark magenta and black gradient background with a glowing halftone dot pattern. Place four overlapping circular frames in the center, each containing a different pop artist portrait. Add horizontal pill-shaped bars at the bottom in semi-transparent magenta.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold uppercase title at the top in a geometric sans-serif with a vertical stripe texture. Place artist names and track titles inside the bottom bars using a clean white sans-serif font. Add a small 'Year' badge at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly four circular portrait frames?
Is the primary color palette magenta, black, and white?
Is the main title the largest element on the page?
Do the bottom bars have rounded 'pill' ends?

adjustableVariables: Color of the accent glow (e.g., blue instead of magenta)
mustRedesign: Specific artist faces must be generic or stock-equivalent
Specific album titles and track names must be replaced with placeholder text
Any specific logos or brand marks
postGenerationChecks: Check for alignment of circular frames
Ensure text in bars is vertically centered
Verify the halftone pattern doesn't obscure the text
Confirm the title has a subtle 3D or textured effect
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark textured background with circular image masks and pill-shaped text containers to create a high-energy 2010s-style music compilation aesthetic.
